sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Life in the waterfront city of Tampa, Florida, was peaceful for 47-year-old Joanne Steffi.
sentences.zh: 对于47岁的乔安妮·斯蒂菲来说，佛罗里达州坦帕市的海滨生活十分宁静。

sentences.en: Her bungalow-style house backed onto a man-made canal that granted access to the sparkling blue waters of Tampa Bay.
sentences.zh: 她的平房式住宅背靠一条人工运河，由此可以通往坦帕湾波光粼粼的蓝色水域。

sentences.en: Small boats headed to and from the harbour puttered past Joanne's home, creating a relaxing coastal-like environment.
sentences.zh: 往返于港口的小船从乔安妮家门前缓缓驶过，营造出一种悠闲的海岸氛围。

sentences.en: Florida's warmth and sunshine added to the appealing atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达温暖的气候和明媚的阳光，更增添了这里的迷人魅力。

sentences.en: In December 1988, a house for sale two doors down from Joanne's was purchased by a couple with a young daughter.
sentences.zh: 1988年12月，一对带着年幼女儿的夫妇买下了乔安妮家隔壁两栋的一处待售房屋。

sentences.en: In a street where residents knew one another and rarely moved, the new neighbours caused a stir.
sentences.zh: 在这条邻里相熟、鲜少搬迁的街道上，新邻居的到来引起了一阵骚动。

sentences.en: While the woman and child were rarely seen, the man of the house was seemingly always outside.
sentences.zh: 虽然很少见到那对母女，但家里的男主人似乎总是在外面活动。

sentences.en: He was big and burly with a friendly and chatty disposition.
sentences.zh: 他身材魁梧，性格友好且健谈。

sentences.en: He encouraged people to call him Obi, after Obi-Wan Kenobi, a mentor-type character from the popular sci-fi film Star Wars.
sentences.zh: 他让大家叫他“欧比”，取自科幻电影《星球大战》中那位导师型角色欧比旺·克诺比。

sentences.en: With his laid-back attitude, casual attire and blue and white powerboat, Obi fit right in.
sentences.zh: 凭借随和的态度、休闲的装束以及那艘蓝白相间的动力艇，欧比很快融入了社区。

sentences.en: In time, the novelty of his family's arrival died down and they blended into the neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 久而久之，他一家人带来的新鲜感逐渐消退，他们也融入了邻里之中。

sentences.en: There was just one problem.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题。

sentences.en: Obi gave Joanne Steffi the creeps.
sentences.zh: 欧比让乔安妮感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: She found his banter superficial and fake, and he had a tendency to appear out of nowhere and insert himself into private conversations.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他的谈吐虚伪做作，而且他总会冷不丁地冒出来，强行介入别人的私人谈话。

sentences.en: Joanne had also developed a hunch that he was hiding something.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮还隐约觉得他藏着什么秘密。

sentences.en: She aired her suspicions to another neighbour, but they considered Obi harmless.
sentences.zh: 她向另一位邻居表达了怀疑，但对方认为欧比并无害处。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Joanne took to avoiding Obi whenever possible.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，乔安妮还是尽量避开欧比。

sentences.en: On a late Saturday night in early 1990, Joanne was in her kitchen when she glanced outside.
sentences.zh: 1990年初的一个周六深夜，乔安妮在厨房时无意间向外瞥了一眼。

sentences.en: A large figure was loitering in the glow of a streetlight close to Joanne's front door.
sentences.zh: 一个高大的身影正徘徊在乔安妮家前门附近的路灯光影中。

sentences.en: It was Obi.
sentences.zh: 是欧比。

sentences.en: He looked to be staring intently at Joanne's house.
sentences.zh: 他看起来正目不转睛地盯着乔安妮的房子。

sentences.en: Joanne turned off the lights to give the impression she was going to bed, then positioned herself by a window.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮关掉灯，假装自己要去睡觉，然后站在窗边观察。

sentences.en: She peered out.
sentences.zh: 她向外窥视。

sentences.en: Obi remained put, his attention transfixed on Joanne's home.
sentences.zh: 欧比一动不动，注意力依然锁定在乔安妮的家中。

sentences.en: Five minutes ticked by before he finally moved, as if awoken from a spell.
sentences.zh: 五分钟过去了，他才终于动了动，仿佛从某种魔咒中惊醒。

sentences.en: He called out something and a little white dog ran up to his feet.
sentences.zh: 他喊了一声，一只小白狗跑到了他的脚边。

sentences.en: Obi then wandered off in the direction of his home.
sentences.zh: 随后，欧比朝着他家的方向走去。

sentences.en: The Rogers family worked hard on their dairy farm in the small village of Wilshire, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯一家在俄亥俄州威尔希尔小村庄的奶牛场辛勤劳作。

sentences.en: 37-year-old patriarch Hal Rogers maintained the 300-acre property full-time.
sentences.zh: 37岁的户主哈尔·罗杰斯全职打理着这片300英亩的农场。

sentences.en: Hal's 36-year-old wife, Joan, better known as Jo, helped out.
sentences.zh: 哈尔36岁的妻子琼（大家都叫她乔）也会帮忙。

sentences.en: Jo also worked nights as a forklift operator.
sentences.zh: 乔晚上还兼职做叉车司机。

sentences.en: Even the couple's two teenage daughters chipped in.
sentences.zh: 就连家里两个十几岁的女儿也会搭把手。

sentences.en: 17-year-old Michelle and 14-year-old Christy Rogers juggled their schoolwork with farm chores.
sentences.zh: 17岁的米歇尔和14岁的克里斯蒂·罗杰斯在农活和学业之间忙得不可开交。

sentences.en: When it came time for the family to take a much-needed break, they excitedly began planning a trip to Florida.
sentences.zh: 当全家人终于迎来期待已久的假期时，他们兴奋地开始筹划去佛罗里达旅行。

sentences.en: The southern coast, with its hundreds of miles of beaches and festive atmosphere, offered a welcome change to the Rogers' inland rural lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 南部海岸拥有绵延数百英里的海滩和节日般的氛围，为罗杰斯一家的内陆农村生活带来了令人欣喜的改变。

sentences.en: Importantly, Florida was the home of the Disney World theme park and resort.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，佛罗里达是迪士尼世界主题公园和度假区的所在地。

sentences.en: While Hal and Jo had been on a few interstate trips throughout their long relationship, visiting Florida would mark the first time Michelle and Christy had left Ohio.
sentences.zh: 虽然哈尔和乔在他们长期的关系中曾去过几次州际旅行，但去佛罗里达将是米歇尔和克里斯蒂第一次离开俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: Michelle eagerly crossed off each passing day on her calendar until her long-awaited holiday finally commenced on Friday, May 26, 1989.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔热切地在日历上划掉每一天，直到她期待已久的假期终于在1989年5月26日星期五开始。

sentences.en: Hal wished he could go to Florida, but his farm needed constant upkeep, so he decided to stay home.
sentences.zh: 哈尔也想去佛罗里达，但农场需要持续打理，所以他决定留在家中。

sentences.en: At 1.30pm, he bid Jo, Michelle and Christy farewell.
sentences.zh: 下午1点30分，他与乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂告别。

sentences.en: The women piled into the family car, a two-door blue Altimobile Calais.
sentences.zh: 女人们挤进了家里的那辆蓝色双门奥尔兹莫比尔Calais轿车。

sentences.en: Jo drove down the dirt driveway headed for Interstate 75.
sentences.zh: 乔沿着土路驶向75号州际公路。

sentences.en: The highway would take them over 1,000 miles south through the streets of Kentucky, Tennessee and Georgia, before reaching Florida.
sentences.zh: 这条公路将载着她们向南行驶1000多英里，穿过肯塔基州、田纳西州和佐治亚州，最终抵达佛罗里达。

sentences.en: The trio were due back on Sunday June 4 at the latest, as Jo had to work on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 三人最迟应在6月4日星期日返回，因为乔周一晚上还要上班。

sentences.en: Days into their trip, Hal received a postcard from Florida's central city, Orlando.
sentences.zh: 旅行开始几天后，哈尔收到了一张来自佛罗里达中心城市奥兰多的明信片。

sentences.en: It contained a message penned by Jo that read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着乔亲笔写下的留言：

sentences.en: Leaving for Disney World for three nights.
sentences.zh: 准备去迪士尼世界玩三天。

sentences.en: Weather is hot and humidity is very high.
sentences.zh: 天气很热，湿度非常高。

sentences.en: Kids having a great time, dragging me everywhere.
sentences.zh: 孩子们玩得很开心，到处拉着我跑。

sentences.en: Better go, have to get Christy out of bed.
sentences.zh: 不说了，得去叫克里斯蒂起床了。

sentences.en: Love you, take care.
sentences.zh: 爱你，保重。

sentences.en: Don't work too hard.
sentences.zh: 别太辛苦了。

sentences.en: When Sunday June 4 arrived, Hal expected the Altimobile to pull up at any moment.
sentences.zh: 当6月4日星期日到来时，哈尔以为奥尔兹莫比尔随时会停在门口。

sentences.en: Yet, the day wore on with no sign of his family.
sentences.zh: 然而，一天过去了，依然不见家人的踪影。

sentences.en: When Jo and the girls hadn't returned by nightfall, Hal began ringing around to see if someone else had heard from them.
sentences.zh: 到了夜幕降临，乔和女儿们还没回来，哈尔开始四处打电话，看看有没有人收到她们的消息。

sentences.en: He discovered that Michelle had called her boyfriend three days earlier on Thursday June 1.
sentences.zh: 他发现米歇尔在三天前的6月1日星期四曾给男友打过电话。

sentences.en: The ten-minute call took place at around lunchtime and had originated from a hotel room in the city of Tampa.
sentences.zh: 那通十分钟的电话是在午餐时间左右打的，地点是坦帕市的一家酒店房间。

sentences.en: Michelle had gushed to her boyfriend about how much fun she was having.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔在电话里兴奋地向男友讲述她玩得有多开心。

sentences.en: The only bad thing she had to say was that she and Christy wanted to go into the ocean, but their mother wouldn't let them because they couldn't swim.
sentences.zh: 她唯一抱怨的是，她和克里斯蒂想去海里玩，但母亲因为她们不会游泳而不让她们去。

sentences.en: Hal Rogers went to bed that night concerned, but told himself that Jo and the girls had probably just extended their holiday for another night.
sentences.zh: 哈尔·罗杰斯那天晚上带着担忧入睡，但他告诉自己，乔和女儿们可能只是多玩了一天。

sentences.en: Perhaps they had found an interesting place to stay on the way home.
sentences.zh: 也许她们在回家的路上发现了什么有趣的地方。

sentences.en: Hal was certain they would reunite on Monday.
sentences.zh: 哈尔确信她们周一就会团聚。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Tampa, police were working diligently into the night following a disturbing discovery.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在坦帕，警方在经历了一次令人不安的发现后，正彻夜忙碌。

sentences.en: Earlier that day, the Coast Guard had received a frantic radio call from a man on a sailboat in Tampa Bay.
sentences.zh: 当天早些时候，海岸警卫队收到了一名在坦帕湾航行的帆船船主的紧急无线电呼叫。

sentences.en: He had sighted something floating in the water and had moved in for a closer look.
sentences.zh: 他看到水里漂着什么东西，于是靠近查看。

sentences.en: It was the lifeless body of a woman.
sentences.zh: 那是一具女性的遗体。

sentences.en: Attempts to lift the body out of the water were hampered by a heavy object that was attached to the woman's neck via a thin yellow rope.
sentences.zh: 由于女子的脖子上系着一根细黄绳，绳子另一端连着一个重物，打捞工作受阻。

sentences.en: After struggling to retrieve the body for 30 minutes, the Coast Guard had no choice but to cut the rope.
sentences.zh: 在努力打捞了30分钟后，海岸警卫队别无选择，只能割断绳子。

sentences.en: The weight that anchored the body sank to the depths, allowing responders to lift the woman's body out with ease.
sentences.zh: 锚定遗体的重物沉入深处，救援人员得以轻松地将女子的遗体打捞上来。

sentences.en: She was naked from the waist down.
sentences.zh: 她腰部以下赤裸。

sentences.en: Her ankles and wrists were hogtied with rope.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝和手腕被绳子捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Duct tape had been placed over her mouth.
sentences.zh: 嘴上贴着胶带。

sentences.en: Realising the gravity of the situation, the Coast Guard alerted the police who organised to meet them at the shore.
sentences.zh: 意识到情况严重，海岸警卫队立即通知了警方，并约定在岸边会合。

sentences.en: Within minutes of having retrieved this body, the Coast Guard received another emergency call.
sentences.zh: 在打捞起这具遗体后不到几分钟，海岸警卫队又接到了另一个紧急呼叫。

sentences.en: A second body had been spotted by a boater four miles away.
sentences.zh: 四英里外的一名船主发现了第二具遗体。

sentences.en: It was another woman.
sentences.zh: 那是另一名女性。

sentences.en: She was also partially naked, hogtied, and gagged with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 她也处于半裸状态，被捆绑并用胶带封口。

sentences.en: The victim had managed to free one of her hands and looked to have tried to remove the tape covering her mouth.
sentences.zh: 受害者曾试图挣脱一只手，看起来像是想撕掉嘴上的胶带。

sentences.en: There was also a thin yellow rope around her neck.
sentences.zh: 她的脖子上也缠着一根细黄绳。

sentences.en: It was tied to a heavy cinder block that responders were able to recover with the body.
sentences.zh: 绳子系着一块沉重的煤渣砖，救援人员将其与遗体一同打捞了上来。

sentences.en: Just as the Coast Guard was travelling back to shore to meet with police, a third woman's body was found in the bay, two miles from the second.
sentences.zh: 就在海岸警卫队返回岸边与警方会合时，在距离第二具遗体两英里外的海湾中又发现了第三名女性的遗体。

sentences.en: The victims presented the same way, making it clear that their murders were connected.
sentences.zh: 受害者的状态如出一辙，这清楚地表明这些谋杀案是相互关联的。

sentences.en: They had been in the water for about two days, which had expedited decomposition and washed away key evidence.
sentences.zh: 她们在水中大约待了两天，这加速了腐烂并冲刷掉了关键证据。

sentences.en: The fact that all three were found naked from the waist down indicated that the crime was sexually motivated.
sentences.zh: 三人都腰部以下赤裸，表明犯罪动机与性有关。

sentences.en: Tidal analysis confirmed the women had entered the water from a boat, as they wouldn't have reached deep water in their condition from a bridge or the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 潮汐分析证实，这些女性是从船上被抛入水中的，因为以她们当时的状态，不可能从桥上或岸边到达深水区。

sentences.en: The cinder blocks tied to their necks were a deliberate act to weigh their bodies down.
sentences.zh: 系在她们脖子上的煤渣砖是有意为之，目的是让遗体沉入水底。

sentences.en: None of the bodies had knife or bullet wounds or anything else to indicate a violent cause of death.
sentences.zh: 所有遗体都没有刀伤、枪伤或其他表明暴力致死的迹象。

sentences.en: This led a medical examiner to assume that they had entered the water while still alive.
sentences.zh: 这让法医推测，她们是在活着的时候被抛入水中的。

sentences.en: It could not be ascertained if the women had died from strangulation or drowning.
sentences.zh: 无法确定这些女性是死于勒死还是溺水。

sentences.en: Their official cause of death was listed as asphyxia.
sentences.zh: 她们的官方死因被列为窒息。

sentences.en: No identification was found with the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在受害者身上没有发现任何身份证明。

sentences.en: Their fingerprints were taken, but they didn't match any on record.
sentences.zh: 警方提取了她们的指纹，但与记录在案的任何指纹都不匹配。

sentences.en: Scouring Tampa Bay for evidence came up dry.
sentences.zh: 对坦帕湾进行的证据搜寻一无所获。

sentences.en: When speaking to the press, authorities were up front.
sentences.zh: 在面对媒体时，当局直言不讳。

sentences.en: They had no motive, no suspects, and no leads.
sentences.zh: 他们没有动机，没有嫌疑人，也没有任何线索。

sentences.en: No one matching the victims' descriptions had been reported missing in the area recently.
sentences.zh: 近期该地区没有报告符合受害者特征的失踪人员。

sentences.en: This led police to believe that the women were from elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 这让警方认为这些女性来自外地。

sentences.en: Florida was a tourist hotspot, especially in the warmer months.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达是旅游热点，尤其是在温暖的月份。

sentences.en: A memo was sent to local hotel owners to be on the lookout for any female guests who had failed to check out.
sentences.zh: 一份备忘录被发给当地酒店业主，要求留意是否有未办理退房手续的女性住客。

sentences.en: Four days after the bodies were discovered, a housekeeper was going about her workday.
sentences.zh: 在遗体被发现四天后，一名客房清洁工正在进行日常工作。

sentences.en: She was employed at the Days Inn, a hotel in the Bayside Tampa neighbourhood of Rocky Point.
sentences.zh: 她受雇于位于坦帕湾洛基角社区的戴斯酒店。

sentences.en: She entered room 251.
sentences.zh: 她进入了251号房间。

sentences.en: The two double beds within were neatly made.
sentences.zh: 里面的两张双人床铺得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: Make-up and toiletries were on the bathroom counter, and clothing was scattered on the dark, teal carpet.
sentences.zh: 洗漱用品和化妆品放在浴室台面上，衣服散落在深青色的地毯上。

sentences.en: The hotel room had appeared exactly the same for the previous four days.
sentences.zh: 过去四天里，这个酒店房间看起来一直都是这样。

sentences.en: The housekeeper informed her manager.
sentences.zh: 清洁工通知了她的经理。

sentences.en: The guests assigned to room 251 hadn't checked out yet.
sentences.zh: 入住251号房间的客人还没有退房。

sentences.en: Their booking was under the name Rogers and applied to Jo Rogers and her two daughters, Michelle and Christy.
sentences.zh: 预订登记的名字是罗杰斯，入住者是乔·罗杰斯和她的两个女儿米歇尔和克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: They had checked into the room at midday on Thursday June 1 and hadn't been seen since.
sentences.zh: 她们于6月1日星期四中午办理了入住，此后再未露面。

sentences.en: Homicide detectives were informed and arrived at the hotel room, where they recovered Jo, Michelle and Christy's fingerprints.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案侦探接到通知后赶到酒店房间，提取了乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂的指纹。

sentences.en: They were cross-checked with the three bodies found in nearby Tampa Bay.
sentences.zh: 这些指纹与在附近坦帕湾发现的三具遗体进行了交叉比对。

sentences.en: The missing women's dental records were also obtained to facilitate an ID check.
sentences.zh: 警方还获取了失踪女性的牙科记录，以协助进行身份确认。

sentences.en: There was absolutely no doubt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: The three murdered women were Jo, Michelle and Christy Rogers.
sentences.zh: 这三名遇害女性正是乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: There were no signs of a struggle in the Rogers hotel room or anything else distinctly criminal.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯的酒店房间里没有打斗迹象，也没有其他明显的犯罪痕迹。

sentences.en: A roll of camera film was taken into evidence and developed.
sentences.zh: 一卷相机胶卷被作为证据带走并冲洗出来。

sentences.en: The second last photo depicted Michelle Rogers sitting on the hotel room's floor.
sentences.zh: 倒数第二张照片显示米歇尔·罗杰斯坐在酒店房间的地板上。

sentences.en: Although sunburned and weary, she did not appear distressed.
sentences.zh: 虽然晒伤且疲惫，但她看起来并不痛苦。

sentences.en: The photo was taken the day the group had checked in.
sentences.zh: 这张照片拍摄于她们入住的那一天。

sentences.en: The final photo was taken from the hotel room's balcony of the sun setting over Tampa Bay.
sentences.zh: 最后一张照片是从酒店房间的阳台上拍摄的，画面是坦帕湾的日落。

sentences.en: This meant the three women had been in their hotel room at dusk on Thursday June 1.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这三名女性在6月1日星期四的黄昏时分还在酒店房间里。

sentences.en: It was unknown where they had gone from there.
sentences.zh: 此后她们去了哪里不得而知。

sentences.en: Notably, the Rogers Blue Oldsmobile wasn't in the hotel parking lot.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，罗杰斯家的蓝色奥尔兹莫比尔轿车并不在酒店停车场。

sentences.en: The search for the car encompassed the nearby perimeter of Tampa Bay, given its significance.
sentences.zh: 鉴于其重要性，搜寻范围扩大到了坦帕湾附近的周边区域。

sentences.en: It was soon discovered in a parking spot at a boat landing closest to the Day's Inn.
sentences.zh: 很快，车子在离戴斯酒店最近的一个码头停车场被发现。

sentences.en: There was nothing to suggest anything amiss had occurred in relation to the vehicle, and only Jo, Michelle and Christy's fingerprints were found in and around it.
sentences.zh: 没有任何迹象表明车辆发生了异常，车内及周围只发现了乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂的指纹。

sentences.en: The Oldsmobile contained a book of semi-complete crossword puzzles, a half-eaten chocolate bar, two decks of playing cards,
sentences.zh: 奥尔兹莫比尔车里有一本未完成的填字游戏书、半块巧克力、两副扑克牌，

sentences.en: and a brochure with directions to the Day's Inn scribbled on it.
sentences.zh: 还有一张上面潦草地写着前往戴斯酒店路线的小册子。

sentences.en: There was also a piece of paper in the front that featured Jo Rogers' handwriting.
sentences.zh: 前座还有一张纸，上面有乔·罗杰斯的笔迹。

sentences.en: She had jotted down the directions to the boat ramp where her car was found, and the words,
sentences.zh: 她记下了前往发现车子的码头的路线，并写道：

sentences.en: Curiously, a blue and white coloured powerboat was sighted in the car park of the Day's Inn on the very day Jo and the girls went missing.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，就在乔和女儿们失踪的那天，有人在戴斯酒店的停车场看到了一艘蓝白相间的动力艇。

sentences.en: The witness recalled the boat was being towed by a dark coloured car.
sentences.zh: 目击者回忆说，那艘船是由一辆深色轿车拖着的。

sentences.en: This looked to be a promising lead.
sentences.zh: 这看起来是一条有希望的线索。

sentences.en: However, blue and white were common boat colours.
sentences.zh: 然而，蓝白配色是船只的常见颜色。

sentences.en: Without anything to help detectives narrow in on this potential clue, it hit a dead end.
sentences.zh: 由于没有其他线索帮助侦探缩小范围，这条线索陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: In the initial stages of their investigation, detectives received close to 1,000 tips.
sentences.zh: 在调查初期，侦探们收到了近1000条举报。

sentences.en: All were looked into, but none led to the killer or killers.
sentences.zh: 所有举报都经过了核查，但没有一条指向凶手。

sentences.en: One detective told the Cincinnati Post newspaper that they were putting all their effort into the case because, quote,
sentences.zh: 一位侦探告诉《辛辛那提邮报》，他们正全力以赴投入此案，因为，引用原话：

sentences.en: Everyone's been shocked by this, even among cops.
sentences.zh: 每个人都对此感到震惊，即使是警察也不例外。

sentences.en: You've got a whole family wiped out, practically.
sentences.zh: 几乎可以说，这一整家人都被灭门了。

sentences.en: Back in Ohio, Hal Rogers was at a loss.
sentences.zh: 远在俄亥俄州的哈尔·罗杰斯不知所措。

sentences.en: Joe, Michelle and Christy were missing.
sentences.zh: 乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂失踪了。

sentences.en: He had initially convinced himself that they were held up sightseeing.
sentences.zh: 起初，他一直说服自己她们只是被耽搁在观光上了。

sentences.en: But once Joe skipped work, Hal knew something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但当乔（Joe）没去上班时，哈尔（Hal）意识到出事了。

sentences.en: He phoned the local police and highway patrol to inform them of the situation.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给当地警方和公路巡警，告知了这一情况。

sentences.en: At one stage, he was asked by police to provide his wife and children's dental records.
sentences.zh: 有一次，警方要求他提供妻子和孩子的牙科记录。

sentences.en: He agreed, though wasn't quite sure why they were needed.
sentences.zh: 他同意了，尽管他不确定为什么需要这些。

sentences.en: By Friday June 9, it had been 14 days since Hal had seen Joe and the girls.
sentences.zh: 到了6月9日星期五，距离哈尔最后一次见到乔和女儿们已经过去14天了。

sentences.en: That day, an unfamiliar car rolled down his driveway.
sentences.zh: 那天，一辆陌生的车开进了他的车道。

sentences.en: A man got out.
sentences.zh: 一名男子走了下来。

sentences.en: He said he worked for a newspaper, then asked Hal for a comment on the drowning murders of Joe, Michelle and Christy.
sentences.zh: 他说他是报社的，随后询问哈尔对乔、米歇尔（Michelle）和克里斯蒂（Christy）溺水谋杀案的看法。

sentences.en: It was the first Hal had heard of it.
sentences.zh: 这是哈尔第一次听说这件事。

sentences.en: He spent the day carrying out his farm work in shock, not knowing what else to do.
sentences.zh: 他整天都在震惊中忙着农活，不知道还能做什么。

sentences.en: He blamed himself for what happened, believing that if he had gone on the Florida trip, then his wife and daughters would still be alive.
sentences.zh: 他把发生的一切归咎于自己，认为如果他当时去了佛罗里达，妻子和女儿们现在可能还活着。

sentences.en: A joint funeral service was held for Joe, Michelle and Christy Rogers.
sentences.zh: 乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂·罗杰斯（Rogers）举行了联合葬礼。

sentences.en: Over 300 Wilshire locals attended, a significant crowd considering the population wasn't much higher.
sentences.zh: 超过300名威尔希尔（Wilshire）当地人参加了葬礼，考虑到当地人口并不多，这算得上是相当庞大的人群。

sentences.en: Joe was remembered as a hard-working woman.
sentences.zh: 人们记忆中的乔是一位勤劳的女性。

sentences.en: Michelle was intelligent and modeSt.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔聪明且谦逊。

sentences.en: Christy was bubbly and sociable.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂活泼且善于交际。

sentences.en: As the Wilshire community grieved, homicide detectives arrived in town.
sentences.zh: 就在威尔希尔社区沉浸在悲痛中时，凶杀案调查组的侦探们抵达了镇上。

sentences.en: They had come to suspect that the answers they sought weren't in Florida, but closer to home.
sentences.zh: 他们开始怀疑，他们寻找的答案并不在佛罗里达，而是在离家更近的地方。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》（Case File）稍后回来。

sentences.en: Just over a year before Joe, Michelle and Christy Rogers were killed, an 18-year-old woman presented to the emergency department of a hospital outside of Wilshire.
sentences.zh: 在乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂·罗杰斯遇害前一年多，一名18岁的女子出现在威尔希尔外一家医院的急诊室。

sentences.en: For the sake of clarity,
sentences.zh: 为了叙述清晰，

sentences.en: Case File will refer to this woman as Zoe.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》将称呼这名女子为佐伊（Zoe）。

sentences.en: Zoe was in a terrified state.
sentences.zh: 佐伊处于极度恐惧的状态。

sentences.en: She reported that she had been raped at knife point on the Rogers dairy farm.
sentences.zh: 她报告说，她在罗杰斯奶牛场被人持刀强奸了。

sentences.en: Zoe identified her attacker as her roommate,
sentences.zh: 佐伊指认袭击者是她的室友，

sentences.en: 31-year-old John Rogers.
sentences.zh: 31岁的约翰·罗杰斯（John Rogers）。

sentences.en: He co-owned the dairy business with his brother, Hal.
sentences.zh: 他和他的兄弟哈尔共同经营着这家奶牛场。

sentences.en: John and Zoe had been residing together in a trailer on site.
sentences.zh: 约翰和佐伊一直住在现场的一辆拖车里。

sentences.en: As detailed in the Tampa Bay Times newspaper,
sentences.zh: 正如《坦帕湾时报》（Tampa Bay Times）所详述的那样，

sentences.en: John Rogers was known locally for being strange.
sentences.zh: 约翰·罗杰斯在当地以古怪著称。

sentences.en: He was an ex-Marine with a muscular build and intimidating presence.
sentences.zh: 他曾是一名海军陆战队员，身材魁梧，给人一种威慑感。

sentences.en: He talked about missions he had allegedly undertaken for the Secret Service and Central Intelligence Agency, better known as the CIA.
sentences.zh: 他经常谈论他声称为特勤局和中央情报局（即CIA）执行的任务。

sentences.en: The content of these stories was enough to compel locals to keep their distance.
sentences.zh: 这些故事的内容足以让当地人对他敬而远之。

sentences.en: Zoe lived with John out of necessity.
sentences.zh: 佐伊是因为生活所迫才与约翰住在一起。

sentences.en: She desperately needed a place to stay.
sentences.zh: 她迫切需要一个住处。

sentences.en: Police arrived at the Rogers farm to question John about Zoe's assault.
sentences.zh: 警方来到罗杰斯农场，就佐伊遇袭一事审问约翰。

sentences.en: As they spoke to John in his trailer, a detective noticed a briefcase on the floor of the living room area.
sentences.zh: 当他们在拖车里与约翰交谈时，一名侦探注意到客厅地板上有一个公文包。

sentences.en: John said the briefcase contained paperwork.
sentences.zh: 约翰说公文包里装的是文件。

sentences.en: He was asked to open it.
sentences.zh: 他被要求打开它。

sentences.en: John fiddled with the briefcase lock for a moment before saying that he had forgotten its combination.
sentences.zh: 约翰摆弄了一会儿公文包的锁，然后说他忘记密码了。

sentences.en: He was then handed a screwdriver and told to use it.
sentences.zh: 随后有人递给他一把螺丝刀，让他用它撬开。

sentences.en: The briefcase actually contained a videotape, five photographs and a cassette tape.
sentences.zh: 公文包里实际上装有一盘录像带、五张照片和一盘卡式录音带。

sentences.en: The videotape featured footage of John sexually assaulting Zoe.
sentences.zh: 录像带里记录了约翰性侵佐伊的画面。

sentences.en: The photographs depicted a different teenager altogether.
sentences.zh: 照片里则是完全不同的另一名少女。

sentences.en: She was naked, blindfolded and bound.
sentences.zh: 她赤身裸体，被蒙住双眼并捆绑着。

sentences.en: The cassette tape was a recording of this young woman screaming for John Rogers to leave her alone.
sentences.zh: 卡式录音带里记录了这名年轻女子尖叫着求约翰·罗杰斯放过她的声音。

sentences.en: Detectives identified this second victim as John's niece, Michelle Rogers.
sentences.zh: 侦探们确认这名受害者是约翰的侄女，米歇尔·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: When police spoke to Michelle, she broke down.
sentences.zh: 当警方与米歇尔谈话时，她崩溃了。

sentences.en: She revealed that her uncle John had been sexually abusing her for almost two years, beginning when Michelle was 14 years old.
sentences.zh: 她透露，她的叔叔约翰已经性虐待她近两年了，从米歇尔14岁时就开始了。

sentences.en: She kept word of the abuse secret, as John had repeatedly threatened to kill her if she spoke out.
sentences.zh: 她一直对虐待的事守口如瓶，因为约翰曾多次威胁说，如果她敢说出去就杀了她。

sentences.en: Hal and Joe Rogers had noticed their oldest daughter seemed nervous around John, but thought it was due to their clashing personalities.
sentences.zh: 哈尔和乔·罗杰斯曾注意到他们的大女儿在约翰面前显得很紧张，但以为是因为他们性格不合。

sentences.en: Michelle protected her younger sister, Christy, by making sure she was never alone with their uncle.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔保护着妹妹克里斯蒂，确保她从不与叔叔单独相处。

sentences.en: John was arrested in mid-February 1988 and was released on bail pending trial.
sentences.zh: 约翰于1988年2月中旬被捕，随后在候审期间获保释。

sentences.en: Hal Rogers had put up the money that secured his brother's freedom, even though Hal's daughter was one of John's victiMs.
sentences.zh: 哈尔·罗杰斯支付了保释金，让他的兄弟重获自由，尽管哈尔的女儿也是约翰的受害者之一。

sentences.en: Hal later explained that he had once given his word to John that he would get him out of jail no matter what.
sentences.zh: 哈尔后来解释说，他曾向约翰承诺过，无论如何都会把他从监狱里救出来。

sentences.en: He did, however, make John sell his share of the dairy farm and told him never to come near his family again.
sentences.zh: 不过，他确实让约翰卖掉了他在奶牛场的股份，并告诉他永远不要再靠近他的家人。

sentences.en: The following year, John Rogers pleaded no contest for the rape of Zoe.
sentences.zh: 次年，约翰·罗杰斯对强奸佐伊的指控表示不抗辩。

sentences.en: To spare Michelle Rogers from having to testify, the charges pertaining to her assault were dropped.
sentences.zh: 为了免除米歇尔·罗杰斯出庭作证的痛苦，有关她遇袭的指控被撤销了。

sentences.en: John ultimately received a 7 to 25 year sentence.
sentences.zh: 约翰最终被判处7到25年监禁。

sentences.en: A month after the trial, Michelle went to Florida with her mother and sister.
sentences.zh: 审判一个月后，米歇尔和母亲及妹妹去了佛罗里达。

sentences.en: It was hoped the change of scenery would help her move forward.
sentences.zh: 人们希望换个环境能帮助她走出阴影。

sentences.en: She was resilient and determined to reclaim her life.
sentences.zh: 她很坚强，决心重新开始生活。

sentences.en: John Rogers had been to Florida.
sentences.zh: 约翰·罗杰斯去过佛罗里达。

sentences.en: He visited the state for a six week holiday while on bail for his sex crimes.
sentences.zh: 他在因性犯罪被保释期间，曾去该州度假了六周。

sentences.en: He went to many of the same locations that Joe, Michelle and Christy would come to visit a year later.
sentences.zh: 他去了许多乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂一年后会去的地方。

sentences.en: John was in prison at the time of the triple homicide, leading detectives to wonder.
sentences.zh: 三起谋杀案发生时，约翰正在监狱里，这让侦探们感到困惑。

sentences.en: Had he made good on his previous threats to Michelle?
sentences.zh: 他是否兑现了之前对米歇尔的威胁？

sentences.en: Could he have made connections in Florida and organised a hit?
sentences.zh: 他是否在佛罗里达建立了人脉并策划了一场雇凶杀人？

sentences.en: Rumours were also circulating that John was involved in a drug and pornography ring.
sentences.zh: 当时还有传言称约翰卷入了一个毒品和色情团伙。

sentences.en: Apparently, Joe was aware, providing another motive why John would target the Rogers women.
sentences.zh: 显然，乔对此有所察觉，这为约翰针对罗杰斯家的女性提供了另一个动机。

sentences.en: Yet, there was no way John could have known that Joe, Michelle or Christy were in Florida.
sentences.zh: 然而，约翰不可能知道乔、米歇尔或克里斯蒂当时在佛罗里达。

sentences.en: He had no visitors in prison or correspondence with the outside world.
sentences.zh: 他在狱中没有访客，也没有与外界联系。

sentences.en: John wasn't the only Rogers family member that raised suspicions.
sentences.zh: 约翰并不是唯一引起怀疑的罗杰斯家族成员。

sentences.en: Gossip in Wilshire spotlighted how Rogers, due to his perceived odd behaviour in the aftermath of the murders of his wife and daughters.
sentences.zh: 威尔希尔的流言蜚语聚焦于哈尔，因为他在妻子和女儿遇害后的表现显得有些古怪。

sentences.en: He didn't cry at their funeral and had taken to wearing tinted glasses.
sentences.zh: 他在葬礼上没有哭，还开始戴上有色眼镜。

sentences.en: A feeling had arisen within the community that Howell was hiding something.
sentences.zh: 社区里开始出现一种感觉，认为哈尔隐瞒了什么。

sentences.en: Detectives checked Howell's bank records and discovered that he had withdrawn $7,000 shortly after his family had gone missing.
sentences.zh: 侦探们查看了哈尔的银行记录，发现他在家人失踪后不久取走了7000美元。

sentences.en: Howell explained that he had intended to use the money to drive to Florida and commence a search.
sentences.zh: 哈尔解释说，他打算用这笔钱开车去佛罗里达开始搜寻。

sentences.en: He said he preferred to carry cash and that he kept the $7,000 in his truck's glove compartment.
sentences.zh: 他说他更喜欢携带现金，并把这7000美元放在了卡车的杂物箱里。

sentences.en: Howell still had the money.
sentences.zh: 哈尔确实还留着这笔钱。

sentences.en: But detectives were open to the possibility that it might have been intended as payment to someone involved in the murders.
sentences.zh: 但侦探们不排除这笔钱可能是支付给谋杀案相关人员的报酬。

sentences.en: While Howell Rogers was enduring the suspicions of his local community, those who knew him well couldn't believe he was being considered a suspect.
sentences.zh: 尽管哈尔·罗杰斯承受着当地社区的怀疑，但那些了解他的人无法相信他会被列为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The loss of his entire family had left him a shell of a man who buried himself in farm work as a distraction.
sentences.zh: 失去整个家庭让他变成了一具空壳，他只能把自己埋在农活中来分散注意力。

sentences.en: Howell willingly took part in a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 哈尔自愿参加了测谎测试。

sentences.en: While the results couldn't be used in any legal capacity, they led police to believe he absolutely wasn't involved in the murders.
sentences.zh: 虽然结果不能作为法律证据，但它们让警方相信他绝对没有参与谋杀。

sentences.en: They came to view Howell as another victim in the case.
sentences.zh: 他们开始将哈尔视为此案的另一名受害者。

sentences.en: The Rogers case was featured in the Florida Department of Law Enforcement bulletin.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯案被刊登在佛罗里达州执法部门的公告中。

sentences.en: The monthly publication was sent to police departments across the state.
sentences.zh: 这份月刊会被发送到全州的警察局。

sentences.en: It detailed unsolved crimes to facilitate the sharing of information to help generate leads.
sentences.zh: 它详细列出了未破案件，以促进信息共享并帮助获取线索。

sentences.en: One Florida-based police officer was going through his paperwork four months after the killings when he came across the latest bulletin.
sentences.zh: 一名佛罗里达州的警官在案发四个月后整理文书时，看到了最新的公告。

sentences.en: He was aware of the Rogers case due to its notoriety, but it was another unsolved crime that caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 他因罗杰斯案的知名度而有所耳闻，但另一桩未破案件引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: For the sake of clarity, case file will refer to the woman involved as Lucy.
sentences.zh: 为了叙述清晰，《案件档案》将称呼涉事女子为露西（Lucy）。

sentences.en: Twenty-four-year-old Lucy was originally from Ontario in Canada.
sentences.zh: 24岁的露西来自加拿大安大略省。

sentences.en: She was visiting Florida on holiday in May 1989, two weeks before Joe, Michelle and Christy's trip.
sentences.zh: 1989年5月，即乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂旅行前两周，她正在佛罗里达度假。

sentences.en: On the night of Sunday the 14th, Lucy had dinner with a female friend.
sentences.zh: 14日星期日晚上，露西和一位女性朋友共进晚餐。

sentences.en: The pair then walked to a nearby convenience store.
sentences.zh: 两人随后步行前往附近的一家便利店。

sentences.en: It was around 9.30 and as the two women walked through the car park, they passed a relatively tall and heavyset man.
sentences.zh: 当时大约是9点半，当两名女子穿过停车场时，她们经过了一名身材较高且魁梧的男子。

sentences.en: Despite having an imposing presence, he struck up a friendly conversation that put Lucy and her friend at ease.
sentences.zh: 尽管他看起来很有压迫感，但他主动发起了友好的交谈，让露西和她的朋友放松了警惕。

sentences.en: He introduced himself as Dave Posner.
sentences.zh: 他自我介绍叫戴夫·波斯纳（Dave Posner）。

sentences.en: Dave warned the women to be careful, saying the crime rate in the area was high.
sentences.zh: 戴夫提醒她们要小心，说该地区的犯罪率很高。

sentences.en: He offered them a ride so they wouldn't have to walk the dark and dangerous streets alone.
sentences.zh: 他主动提出载她们一程，这样她们就不必独自走在黑暗危险的街道上。

sentences.en: Lucy and her friend accepted and got into Dave's dark-coloured vehicle.
sentences.zh: 露西和她的朋友接受了，并上了戴夫那辆深色的车。

sentences.en: It was a pleasant drive.
sentences.zh: 那是一段愉快的车程。

sentences.en: At one stage, Lucy spoke of wanting to go fishing while in Florida.
sentences.zh: 有一次，露西提到想在佛罗里达钓鱼。

sentences.en: Dave told her that he had a powerboat and would be happy to take her out in Tampa Bay.
sentences.zh: 戴夫告诉她，他有一艘动力艇，很乐意带她去坦帕湾（Tampa Bay）玩。

sentences.en: Certain her friend would join them,
sentences.zh: 确信她的朋友会一起去，

sentences.en: Lucy made plans for the three of them to meet again the following day, at 2pm.
sentences.zh: 露西计划三人第二天下午2点再见面。

sentences.en: However, Lucy's friend didn't want to go.
sentences.zh: 然而，露西的朋友不想去。

sentences.en: She couldn't explain why exactly, but Dave gave her the creeps.
sentences.zh: 她说不出具体原因，但戴夫让她感到毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Undeterred, Lucy went without her.
sentences.zh: 露西没有被劝阻，独自去了。

sentences.en: She met Dave as planned, and the two headed out in his blue and white boat.
sentences.zh: 她按计划见到了戴夫，两人乘着他的蓝白相间的船出发了。

sentences.en: The water was rough in the bay, so they didn't venture far.
sentences.zh: 海湾里的水流很急，所以他们没有走远。

sentences.en: Dave appeared disappointed that Lucy's friend didn't join them, but was otherwise upbeat.
sentences.zh: 戴夫似乎对露西的朋友没来感到失望，但除此之外情绪高涨。

sentences.en: He made easy conversation, talking about his family and mentioning his job as an aluminium salesman.
sentences.zh: 他谈笑风生，聊起自己的家庭，还提到他是一名铝制品推销员。

sentences.en: Four hours after they had set off, Dave dropped Lucy back off at the pier.
sentences.zh: 出发四小时后，戴夫把露西送回了码头。

sentences.en: It was 6.30pm, and the pair were about to go their separate ways, when Dave had an idea.
sentences.zh: 当时是下午6点半，两人正准备分道扬镳，戴夫突然有个主意。

sentences.en: He said Tampa Bay was more beautiful at sunset, and offered to take Lucy and her friend out on the water in an hour's time to experience it.
sentences.zh: 他说坦帕湾的日落更美，并提议一小时后带露西和她的朋友去水上欣赏。

sentences.en: Lucy walked back to where she was staying and let her friend know.
sentences.zh: 露西走回住处并告诉了她的朋友。

sentences.en: But her friend still refused to be around Creepy Dave.
sentences.zh: 但她的朋友仍然拒绝靠近那个“毛骨悚然的戴夫”。

sentences.en: When Lucy returned to the pier alone, Dave became irritated and almost angry.
sentences.zh: 当露西独自回到码头时，戴夫变得烦躁，甚至有些愤怒。

sentences.en: He collected himself and helped Lucy back on his boat.
sentences.zh: 他平复了一下情绪，帮露西回到了船上。

sentences.en: As darkness fell, Dave steered his boat out to deeper waters.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临，戴夫把船开向了更深的水域。

sentences.en: Other vessels disappeared from view, and Lucy felt scared.
sentences.zh: 其他船只消失在视野中，露西感到害怕。

sentences.en: She asked Dave to take her back to shore.
sentences.zh: 她要求戴夫带她回岸上。

sentences.en: He refused and ordered her to sit on his lap.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了，并命令她坐在他的腿上。

sentences.en: Lucy screamed.
sentences.zh: 露西尖叫起来。

sentences.en: Dave responded bluntly,
sentences.zh: 戴夫直截了当地回应道：

sentences.en: Do you think anyone will hear you?
sentences.zh: “你以为会有人听到你的声音吗？”

sentences.en: He then threatened to duct tape Lucy's mouth shut if she didn't stop.
sentences.zh: 随后他威胁说，如果她不闭嘴，就用胶带封住她的嘴。

sentences.en: When he made his intentions to rape Lucy clear, she refused to give in.
sentences.zh: 当他明确表示要强奸露西时，她拒绝屈服。

sentences.en: Is it really worth losing your life over?
sentences.zh: “为了这个丢掉性命真的值得吗？”

sentences.en: He asked.
sentences.zh: 他问道。

sentences.en: After raping Lucy, Dave vomited over the side of his boat.
sentences.zh: 强奸露西后，戴夫在船边呕吐了。

sentences.en: He then drove back to land, stopping every so often to vomit some more.
sentences.zh: 他随后开车回陆地，并不时停下来呕吐。

sentences.en: When the boat reached shallow water, Lucy jumped out.
sentences.zh: 当船到达浅水区时，露西跳了下去。

sentences.en: Dave told her to watch her step, then drove away.
sentences.zh: 戴夫叫她小心脚下，然后开车离开了。

sentences.en: Lucy reported the assault and helped facilitate a composite sketch of her assailant.
sentences.zh: 露西报了案，并协助绘制了袭击者的模拟画像。

sentences.en: The image depicted a balding and weathered man in his late 30s, with blue eyes, short reddish-brown hair and a moustache.
sentences.zh: 画像描绘了一名30多岁、秃顶、饱经风霜的男子，有着蓝色的眼睛、短红棕色头发和胡子。

sentences.en: Dave Posner managed to elude police, resulting in the publication of Lucy's case in the Florida Department of Law Enforcement Bulletin.
sentences.zh: 戴夫·波斯纳成功躲过了警察的追捕，导致露西的案件被刊登在佛罗里达州执法部门的公告中。

sentences.en: Reading about Lucy's ordeal alongside the Rogers murders led one officer to notice the similarities between the two cases.
sentences.zh: 在阅读了露西的遭遇以及罗杰斯谋杀案后，一名警官注意到了两起案件之间的相似之处。

sentences.en: A dark-coloured vehicle was mentioned, as was a blue and white powerboat.
sentences.zh: 提到了深色的车，还有一艘蓝白相间的动力艇。

sentences.en: Duct tape.
sentences.zh: 胶带。

sentences.en: Sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 性侵犯。

sentences.en: All the women were tourists and had their clothing from the waist down removed.
sentences.zh: 所有受害者都是游客，且腰部以下的衣物都被脱掉了。

sentences.en: It was believed Jo and her daughters were lured into a boat in a manner similar to that of Lucy, hence why their car was at the ramp.
sentences.zh: 人们认为乔和她的女儿们是以类似于露西的方式被诱骗上船的，这就是为什么她们的车会停在坡道上。

sentences.en: A behaviour analysis of the Rogers killer conducted by the FBI aligned with Dave Posner.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局（FBI）对罗杰斯案凶手的行为分析与戴夫·波斯纳相吻合。

sentences.en: They had described the killer as intelligent with good social skills.
sentences.zh: 他们将凶手描述为聪明且具有良好社交能力的人。

sentences.en: He was adept at making people feel at ease while presenting himself as a regular and hard-working, law-abiding citizen.
sentences.zh: 他擅长让人们感到放松，同时表现得像一个普通、勤劳且守法的公民。

sentences.en: His crimes would come as a surprise to those who knew him.
sentences.zh: 他的罪行会让那些认识他的人感到震惊。

sentences.en: Due to the killer's familiarity with the area and the fact he owned a boat, he most certainly lived in Tampa.
sentences.zh: 由于凶手对该地区很熟悉，而且他拥有一艘船，他几乎肯定住在坦帕。

sentences.en: The FBI believed Jo, Michelle and Christie were not his first victims and that he would strike again.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局认为，乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂并不是他的首批受害者，而且他还会再次作案。

sentences.en: Locating Dave Posner became a high priority.
sentences.zh: 找到戴夫·波斯纳成了当务之急。

sentences.en: Detectives weighed up the risk of tracking Dave down versus the chance he'd flee if he knew they were coming for him.
sentences.zh: 侦探们权衡了追踪戴夫的风险，以及如果让他知道警方正在接近，他可能会潜逃的风险。

sentences.en: The crimes were too significant to take a reserved approach, so officers decided to circulate the composite sketch of Dave in local newspapers
sentences.zh: 这些罪行性质极其严重，不能采取保守的手段，因此警官们决定在当地报纸上发布戴夫的模拟画像，

sentences.en: in the hopes someone would recognise him.
sentences.zh: 希望有人能认出他来。

sentences.en: Saturday, November 4, 1989 was five months to the day
sentences.zh: 1989年11月4日，星期六，距离

sentences.en: Jo, Michelle and Christie Rogers left for their fateful trip to Florida.
sentences.zh: 乔、米歇尔和克里斯蒂·罗杰斯踏上那趟前往佛罗里达的致命旅程，正好过去了五个月。

sentences.en: Tampa resident Joanne Steffi was sitting at her kitchen table reading the paper.
sentences.zh: 坦帕居民乔安妮·斯特菲正坐在餐桌旁看报纸。

sentences.en: The Rogers case was being spotlighted once again as a composite sketch of a possible suspect was now available.
sentences.zh: 罗杰斯一案再次成为焦点，因为现在已经有了嫌疑人的模拟画像。

sentences.en: Joanne read about the case but had to set the paper aside upon realising she was running late for an appointment.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮读到了这个案件，但意识到自己赴约快迟到了，不得不放下报纸。

sentences.en: As she drove along her street, Joanne passed the home belonging to her creepy neighbour, locally known as Obie.
sentences.zh: 当她开车经过自己所在的街道时，路过了她那位令人毛骨悚然的邻居的家，当地人称他为“奥比”。

sentences.en: It suddenly dawned on her.
sentences.zh: 她突然意识到了一件事。

sentences.en: Obie resembled the suspect sketch in the Rogers homicide case.
sentences.zh: 奥比长得和罗杰斯谋杀案中嫌疑人的画像很像。

sentences.en: He also drove a dark coloured car and owned a blue and white powerboat.
sentences.zh: 他也开着一辆深色的车，还有一艘蓝白相间的动力艇。

sentences.en: Joanne clipped the suspect sketch out of the paper and showed it to her friend and fellow neighbour, a woman named Moselle.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮把报纸上的嫌疑人画像剪了下来，拿给她的朋友兼邻居莫塞尔看。

sentences.en: Moselle warned Joanne not to implicate Obie unless Joanne was absolutely certain of her theory.
sentences.zh: 莫塞尔警告乔安妮，除非她对自己的推测有绝对把握，否则不要牵连奥比。

sentences.en: Joanne agreed and took the clipping home where she stuck it to her fridge.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮同意了，把剪报带回家贴在了冰箱上。

sentences.en: It remained there until early the following year when Joanne happened to spot Obie watching her house from the street one night.
sentences.zh: 剪报一直贴在那里，直到第二年年初，一天晚上，乔安妮偶然发现奥比正从街上盯着她家看。

sentences.en: Scared of what Obie might have been capable of,
sentences.zh: 因为害怕奥比可能做出什么事来，

sentences.en: Joanne spoke to a deputy sheriff who said he would look into it.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮找了一位副警长，对方说会调查一下。

sentences.en: Weeks passed with no news, leading Joanne to assume authorities had investigated Obie and cleared him of any involvement in the Rogers case.
sentences.zh: 几周过去了，没有任何消息，乔安妮以为警方已经调查过奥比，并排除了他与罗杰斯一案的关联。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持《案件档案》继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Two years passed without any breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 两年过去了，没有任何突破。

sentences.en: In October 1991, a Florida-based police sergeant named Glenn Moore joined the team investigating the Rogers case.
sentences.zh: 1991年10月，一位名叫格伦·摩尔的佛罗里达州警官加入了罗杰斯案的调查组。

sentences.en: It was hoped a fresh pair of eyes might uncover something previously missed.
sentences.zh: 人们希望换个角度审视案件，或许能发现之前遗漏的线索。

sentences.en: Moore and the team went over all the information they had.
sentences.zh: 摩尔和调查组重新梳理了他们掌握的所有信息。

sentences.en: Their attention soon turned to a brochure that was found in the Rogers family car.
sentences.zh: 他们的注意力很快转向了在罗杰斯一家的车里发现的一份宣传册。

sentences.en: It was for Clearwater Beach, a popular coastal resort about 15 miles from Tampa.
sentences.zh: 那是关于克利尔沃特海滩的，一个距离坦帕约15英里的热门海滨度假胜地。

sentences.en: The brochure was found to have originated from a tourist stop near the Georgia-Florida border.
sentences.zh: 经查，这份宣传册来自佐治亚州和佛罗里达州边界附近的一个旅游站点。

sentences.en: Anyone linked to the brochure and distribution had already been questioned and cleared.
sentences.zh: 任何与该宣传册及其分发有关的人员都已接受过询问并被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: The brochure featured handwritten directions to the Rogers Tampa-based hotel.
sentences.zh: 宣传册上用手写体标注了前往罗杰斯一家入住的戴斯酒店的路线。

sentences.en: Whoever scrawled them had a very distinct writing style.
sentences.zh: 写下这些字的人笔迹非常独特。

sentences.en: They put capital letters among the lower case and their letter Y had a uniquely long tail.
sentences.zh: 他在小写字母中夹杂了大写字母，而且字母“Y”的尾巴长得很有特点。

sentences.en: This piqued Sergeant Moore's intereSt.
sentences.zh: 这引起了摩尔警官的兴趣。

sentences.en: The handwriting did not match Joe's, Michelle's, or Christie's.
sentences.zh: 笔迹与乔、米歇尔或克里斯蒂的都不符。

sentences.en: Sergeant Moore pondered the likelihood that Joe and the girls got lost en route to the Days Inn and had asked someone for directions.
sentences.zh: 摩尔警官推测，乔和女孩们在去戴斯酒店的路上迷了路，并向人问了路。

sentences.en: The brochure was checked for prints, revealing a partial palm print that didn't belong to any of the three Rogers women.
sentences.zh: 警方对宣传册进行了指纹鉴定，发现了一个不属于罗杰斯家三名女性中任何一人的部分掌纹。

sentences.en: Sergeant Moore came up with a novel idea.
sentences.zh: 摩尔警官想出了一个新颖的主意。

sentences.en: He had the handwriting from the brochure printed in newspapers and posted on billboards in the Tampa area.
sentences.zh: 他把宣传册上的笔迹印在报纸上，并贴在坦帕地区的广告牌上。

sentences.en: It was accompanied with the message,
sentences.zh: 随附的信息是：

sentences.en: Who wrote these directions?
sentences.zh: 谁写下了这些路线？

sentences.en: You may know who killed the Rogers family.
sentences.zh: 你可能知道是谁杀害了罗杰斯一家。

sentences.en: A $25,000 reward was also on offer as an added incentive.
sentences.zh: 作为额外激励，还悬赏了2.5万美元。

sentences.en: Joanne Steffi saw the handwriting sample in the local paper and took it to her friend, Moselle.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮·斯特菲在当地报纸上看到了笔迹样本，并把它拿给朋友莫塞尔看。

sentences.en: Moselle had been listening to Joanne's worries about their neighbour, Obi, for some time.
sentences.zh: 莫塞尔听乔安妮担心邻居奥比已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: Obi was an aluminium salesman who had previously provided Moselle with a quote for work she wanted done to her front porch.
sentences.zh: 奥比是一名铝制品推销员，之前曾为莫塞尔想要装修的前廊提供过报价。

sentences.en: He had written out an estimate and given her a carbon copy.
sentences.zh: 他写了一份估价单，并给了她一份复写件。

sentences.en: Moselle searched for hours and eventually found the estimate buried among paperwork.
sentences.zh: 莫塞尔找了几个小时，终于在一堆文件中找到了那份估价单。

sentences.en: She and Joanne compared it to the sample in a newspaper article.
sentences.zh: 她和乔安妮将其与报纸上的样本进行了对比。

sentences.en: It was an exact match.
sentences.zh: 完全吻合。

sentences.en: Joanne mailed and faxed it to the local police headquarters.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮将其邮寄并传真给了当地警察总部。

sentences.en: She then waited to hear on the news that Obi, whose real name was Oba Chandler, had been arrested in relation to the Rogers triple homicide.
sentences.zh: 随后她等待着新闻报道奥比（真名奥巴·钱德勒）因涉及罗杰斯三人谋杀案而被捕的消息。

sentences.en: She heard nothing.
sentences.zh: 但她什么也没听到。

sentences.en: Joanne made several follow-up calls to find out if the police could analyse the handwriting samples she had sent.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮打了好几个后续电话，想知道警方是否能分析她寄去的笔迹样本。

sentences.en: She was told that the case investigators were making their way through a large amount of leads and that hers would be examined in time.
sentences.zh: 她被告知案件调查人员正在处理大量的线索，她的线索会及时得到审查。

sentences.en: June passed and by late July,
sentences.zh: 六月过去了，到了七月下旬，

sentences.en: Joanne was still awaiting contact from authorities.
sentences.zh: 乔安妮仍在等待警方的联系。

sentences.en: Frustrated by their lack of action,
sentences.zh: 由于对警方的不作为感到沮丧，

sentences.en: Moselle's adult daughter faxed the handwriting samples through to police again.
sentences.zh: 莫塞尔的成年女儿再次将笔迹样本传真给了警方。

sentences.en: Her accompanying message read,
sentences.zh: 随附的信息写道：

sentences.en: Here is another copy of Oba Chandler's handwriting.
sentences.zh: 这是奥巴·钱德勒笔迹的另一份副本。

sentences.en: Many of us are convinced that his handwriting is the one published in the papers.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人都确信，他的笔迹就是报纸上刊登的那份。

sentences.en: We feel so strongly that they are one and the same that due to your lack of response, we were tempted to pursue this with a handwriting expert of our own.
sentences.zh: 我们非常确信它们是同一个人所写，由于你们一直没有回应，我们打算自己找笔迹专家进行鉴定。

sentences.en: Following this, investigators were willing to take on the concerns of Joanne Steffi and her neighbours.
sentences.zh: 此后，调查人员愿意采纳乔安妮·斯特菲及其邻居们的担忧。

sentences.en: Within three days, her handwriting expert confirmed that the directions on the Clearwater Beach brochure were indeed penned by Oba Chandler.
sentences.zh: 三天之内，她的笔迹专家证实，克利尔沃特海滩宣传册上的路线确实是奥巴·钱德勒亲笔所写。

sentences.en: It was such a close match, it was regarded as unmistakable.
sentences.zh: 笔迹吻合度极高，被认为是无可辩驳的。

sentences.en: While this only proved that Chandler had given the Rogers women directions, it established that he had direct contact with them in the lead-up to their murders.
sentences.zh: 虽然这只能证明钱德勒曾为罗杰斯家的女性指路，但这证实了他在她们遇害前与她们有过直接接触。

sentences.en: And he knew where they were staying.
sentences.zh: 而且他知道她们住在哪里。

sentences.en: Yet, by the time police closed in on Oba Chandler, they were too late.
sentences.zh: 然而，当警方锁定奥巴·钱德勒时，已经太晚了。

sentences.en: He was long gone.
sentences.zh: 他早就逃之夭夭了。
